linker_contract: sections.ld.in defines _iram_start at the vector section start and _iram_end after IRAM sections; memory_layout.c reserves that complete interval before heap registration

only_standard_non8bit_region.condition: instruction cache16KiB AND memory protection disabled
only_standard_non8bit_region.normal_static_coverage: The contiguous normal vectors/text cover the entire candidate region. SDK reserved-memory subtraction removes it from allocatable heap even if enabled.

conclusion: No additional standard SDK 32bit-only/EXEC allocatable heap is omitted by the normal baseline 8BIT views. This is a source/linker-domain conclusion, not a captured caps0 runtime sample. RTC-fast allocatable RAM is included in 8BIT; physical/cache/ROM/boot/reserved domains still require separate accounting. No grand total is asserted.
provenance_limit: The generated SDK header/ELF were replaced during the next build; this audit deliberately uses retained normal sections and SDK region/reservation logic, not relabeling the new header as normal-firmware evidence. Custom application region registration is absent from the selected adapter; SDK explicit custom-cap additions found are PSRAM-only, not selected here.
